title: New Connection and Re-Verification KYC Procedure
content:
New Connection and Re-Verification KYC Procedure

Document ID: SOP_C17_KYC_VERIFICATION

Category: C17 — KYC & Identity Verification

Department: Compliance

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To ensure all new connections and periodic re-verifications meet regulatory KYC standards.

Scope

Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below.

Preconditions

Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable).

Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold.

Roles & Responsibilities

Required Information

Registered mobile number / account ID.

Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued.

Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable.

Procedure

Collect one Proof of Identity and one Proof of Address from the approved document list.

For Aadhaar-based e-KYC, obtain explicit customer consent before OTP-based verification.

For video-KYC, complete the liveness check, geo-tag capture, and document-to-face match.

Reject and request re-submission if any document is illegible, expired, or mismatched.

Store verification records per the data retention schedule in Policy_C19_privacy_policy.

Decision Points

If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing.

If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP.

Exception Handling

Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding.

Validation

Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable.

Escalation

Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated to the next tier with full interaction history attached, and the customer is informed of the new reference and expected timeline.

SLA / Timing

First-line resolution target is same working day; escalations to specialist teams carry a 2-3 working day SLA.

Audit Requirements

Every action taken under this SOP must be logged against the account with agent ID, timestamp, and outcome for audit and quality-review purposes.
